title: Digital arrest scam kaise chalta hai?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: Video call pe CBI officer... aap ARREST ho!
Is scam ne 4 hazaar crore loote!
Pehle darr: tumhare parcel me drugs!
[excited] Sach: police video pe arrest nahi karti!
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
Video call aaya: "Main CBI officer bol raha hoon... aap DIGITAL ARREST me ho!" 😨

Ye ek scam hai. Sarkari data ke hisaab se 2022 se May 2026 tak digital arrest scam me log ₹4,057 crore se zyada gawa chuke hain (lagbhag 3 lakh complaints).

Kaise chalta hai: pehle darr ("tumhare naam ke parcel me drugs mile" ya Aadhaar ka misuse), phir video call pe nakli police station jaisa studio, uniform aur nakli warrant. Phir camera on rakhwa ke kisi ko batane nahi dete... aur "case khatam karne" ke naam pe paise transfer karwa lete hain.

Sach: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) ki advisory: CBI, ED, police ya judge video call pe arrest NAHI karte. Aisa call aaye toh turant kaato aur 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo. 🚨

Ye baat mummy-papa aur dada-dadi ko zaroor batao. Agla "kaise" kis cheez ka chahiye? Comment karo 👇
